patch_description: This design combines graph-aware parameter sharing with a single axis-selective trainable interaction. Amplitude rotations are shared only across structurally related wire pairs, while independent phase rotations preserve local expressivity. The costly three-qubit interaction and peripheral controlled rotations are omitted; instead, the high-connectivity edge (0,7) uses CRY to learn correlation strength directly. This keeps the full interaction graph, reduces depth relative to the current higher-order design, and holds the total parameter count to 96 across repetitions.
